passages.text: Respond to something from feeling instead of analysis

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Take ownership of one area where you have choice

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: List 3 gifts of your current age that younger you didn't have

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Integrate rather than choose: honor all your cultural threads

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Express one quality you've suppressed due to gender expectations

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Meditate on: 'I am not what I do. I am the one who does.'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Post something genuinely unpolished and real

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Genuinely bow to the wisdom in someone you consider 'unconscious'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Say 'You're right, I was wrong' about one thing today

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Either brag openly or stay genuinely quiet about it

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Say 'I don't know enough about that' genuinely

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Have a conversation without referencing anyone else's name

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Genuinely listen to someone else's pain without comparing

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Listen and learn from someone you'd normally teach

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Celebrate someone's success and notice nothing is taken from you

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Receive feedback with just 'Thank you, I'll think about that'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Learn something from someone whose life seems 'easy'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Spend an entire conversation asking questions and listening

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Feel genuine gratitude for ONE tiny thing — even just a breath

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Give something with absolutely zero expectation of return

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Accept a compliment fully: 'Thank you, I worked hard on that'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Explain your expertise to a child and find joy in their understanding

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Sit quietly and whisper 'I am enough' — not as affirmation but as experiment
